title: Fused embedding pipeline
description: Integrate GEOM, LINCS, JUMP and NCI60 features into compound embeddings.

downloads.description: Optional downloads YAML; uses the bundled configuration when omitted.

embeddings.description: Optional model YAML; uses the bundled configuration when omitted.

raw_data.description: Optional directory containing HDD, JUMP, GEOM and LINCS subdirectories. On DNAnexus use a dx://project-ID:/folder URI. Otherwise download the inputs.

viability.description: Optional prepared NCI60 response CSV. Otherwise download and prepare the PharmacoSet.

container_image.description: Docker image registry digest or dx://project-ID:file-ID of an uploaded Docker image archive. Required for the DNAnexus profile.

outdir.description: Output subdirectory. Must be relative on DNAnexus; the cloud profile defaults to results.
